title: How a Failed 1957 Wallpaper Became Bubble Wrap 🫧
description:
How did a failed wallpaper become bubble wrap? In 1957, two engineers in New Jersey sealed two shower curtains together, trapping rows of air bubbles inside, and tried to sell it as fancy textured wallpaper. Nobody wanted bumpy walls. They tried it as greenhouse insulation, and that flopped too.

Then a computer maker needed to ship its delicate new machine without a single crack. The bubbles took the bumps, the computers arrived safe, and packing was never the same.

What's the most satisfying thing to pop? Tell us below.
